appearance: Predominantly wet/overcast with low cloud over wooded hills.
layout: Red Bull Ring F1 10-corner layout; exclude MotoGP-only chicane at approximately823m.
sector_registration: All stations in retained native origin. Approximate full-route zones; individual decor must stay beyond verified protection and runoff.

sectors.name: Main straight and Niki Lauda T1
sectors.observed_environment: Long red-seated covered main stand opposite tiered glazed pits. Outside T1 hillside grandstand; broad red/white kerbs and corner-specific painted/asphalt escape beyond steep grass banks.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Uphill to Remus T3
sectors.observed_environment: Steep uphill road with conifer woodland and grass embankments, outside open bleachers at hairpin. Wide red-painted/red-white escape apron at braking zone; no F1 chicane midway up.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Downhill Schlossgold T4
sectors.observed_environment: Strong downhill grade and open valley views; forests beyond. Infield Red Bull bull-and-ring sculpture visible offset from track; wide corner-specific runoff and barriers on elevated banks.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Rauch and Würth middle corners
sectors.observed_environment: Sweeping downhill curves bordered by grass, red/white kerbs, gravel/asphalt outside and open hillside spectator seating. Conifer ridges frame the entire view.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Rindt and Red Bull Mobile
sectors.observed_environment: Fast descending right-hand finish sequence; pit and main-stand roofs across valley. Green outer strips, red/white kerbs and a limited orange/black raised kerb element near pit entry.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

sectors.name: Pit entry and finish
sectors.observed_environment: Close pit complex, long glazed hospitality upper floor and deep steel stand roof; low service pavilions and timing structures rather than city blocks.
sectors.placement_confidence: Sector-level reconstruction; boundaries and depths inferred, not measured from video.

terrain.retained_source: Land Steiermark / GIS-Steiermark, current classified-ground ALS DGM
terrain.shortcomings: Current mosaic combines older1 m and2022–2023 .5 m lidar; per-pixel flight selection and asphalt resurfacing epochs are not asserted. NativeXY road registration remains approximately2 m uncertain. The12 m scenery grid does not resolve kerb drains or retaining-wall faces; authored roads and real retaining geometry remain separate.
terrain.data_status: Official numeric F32 2 m road and4 m fullscenery exports retained. Every cell of previous12 m scenery lattice is covered; no extrapolation or oldDSM fallback. Root materializes terrain.bin from scenery-ground.json before scene generation.
terrain.racing_deck_correction: The road now samples official classified-ground Styria ALS DGM. See elevation-corrections.json for exact source export, filtering and registration uncertainty. Surrounding scenery is only replaced when the retained scenery-ground.json manifest is supplied.

authoring_constraints: Use mapped building footprints and match rooflines, structural supports, facade depth and stepped volumes; names alone do not establish likeness.
Place grass/gravel/asphalt runoff per registered corner, with protection at outside edge; do not fill escape areas with independent tiles/blocks.
Road, kerbs, shoulder and protection share smooth station sampling; kerbs only in explicit ranges.
Maintain venue-specific vegetation around complete route, preserving long sightlines/open water where present.
Reference pixels remain ignored; generate geometry and materials only.
quality_gates: Matching cockpit frame at each sector and every braking/turn sequence.
Oblique view of runoff shapes, architectural footprints and terrain.
Full lap motion review for edge smoothness, floating objects, protection gaps and missing surroundings.
Luna high reviewer must evaluate rendered evidence, not this recipe.

width_profile.source_publisher: Red Bull Ring operator, FIA-hosted Austrian Grand Prix2024 media kit
width_profile.source_note: Circuit details specify12–13 m track width. This replaces the former generic12–15 m curvature-derived estimate. Main straight uses13 m; narrow corner controls use12 m, with12.5–13 m on the broad connecting straights. Local station transitions are reconstructed from registered corners and supplied video, not surveyed white-line edges.
width_profile.interpolation: Smooth cubic transitions between explicit station controls; no instantaneous-curvature width inference.
